title: Chick eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- chick body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='62' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#FFD23F'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='62' rx='24' ry='22' fill='none' stroke='#FFE98A' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- wing -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='62' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#F5B800'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='36' r='17' fill='#FFD23F'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='36' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#FFE98A' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- tuft -->
  <path d='M44 20 Q46 12 50 18 Q52 10 56 19' fill='none' stroke='#F5B800' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='3.2' fill='#2A1B4A'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='34' r='3.2' fill='#2A1B4A'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='33' r='1.1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='33' r='1.1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- beak, open toward snack -->
  <path d='M60 40 L74 36 L60 32 Z' fill='#FF8A2B'/>
  <path d='M60 38 L73 37 L60 42 Z' fill='#E06A10'/>
  <!-- snack: bread/cracker bit -->
  <rect x='72' y='30' width='16' height='12' rx='4' fill='#C97B3C'/>
  <rect x='72' y='30' width='16' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#E0A060'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='36' r='1.2' fill='#A85D26'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#A85D26'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M36 83 L31 90 M36 83 L36 91 M36 83 L41 90' stroke='#FF8A2B' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M54 83 L49 90 M54 83 L54 91 M54 83 L59 90' stroke='#FF8A2B' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- crumbs -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='47' r='1.6' fill='#E0A060'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='52' r='1.2' fill='#C97B3C'/>
</svg>
